The test image shows a tomato leaf with:
- Marginal/edge necrosis (dark brown to black at leaf margins and lobe tips)
- General yellowing/chlorosis across the leaf
- Necrosis progressing from margins inward
- No distinct circular spots, powdery coating, or mosaic pattern

Affected part: **leaf**. Leaf-affecting candidates from our class list: Bacterial_Canker_And_Wilt_Of_Tomato, Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato, Cucumber_Mosaic_Virus, Early_Blight, Gray_Mold, Late_Blight, Leaf_Mold, Phytophthora_Blight, Powdery_Mildew, Septoria_Leaf_Blotch, Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus, Verticillium_Wilt.

Top candidates: Verticillium_Wilt (V-shaped marginal necrosis with yellowing), Late_Blight, Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus.

Starting with Verticillium_Wilt reference:
Excellent match! Verticillium_Wilt shows V-shaped marginal necrosis with yellow border — very similar to test image. Now checking Late_Blight:
Late_Blight shows large brown papery tissue with white sporulation — less similar. Now Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus:
TSWV shows ring patterns and bronzing — different from test image. Now Early_Blight:
Early_Blight shows concentric ring spots — different. Now Bacterial_Canker_And_Wilt_Of_Tomato:
Bacterial_Canker shows marginal browning but more scorching without yellowing. Now Septoria_Leaf_Blotch:
Septoria shows small circular spots — clearly different. Now Leaf_Mold:
Leaf_Mold shows pale spots — different. Final reference, Phytophthora_Blight:

**Summary of all 8 references viewed:**

| Class | Similarity |
|---|---|
| Verticillium_Wilt | **HIGH** — V-shaped marginal necrosis with yellow border, nearly identical to test |
| Late_Blight | Low — large brown papery lesions, water-soaked appearance |
| Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus | Low — ring patterns and bronzing |
| Early_Blight | Low — concentric ring spots |
| Bacterial_Canker_And_Wilt | Moderate — marginal browning but no yellow border |
| Septoria_Leaf_Blotch | Low — small circular spots scattered across leaf |
| Leaf_Mold | Low — pale spots on leaf surface |
| Phytophthora_Blight | Low — large wilted brown area, different appearance |

The Verticillium_Wilt reference (LeafNet_265) is a near-perfect visual match: dark brown/black necrosis at the leaf margins and lobe tips, with a clear yellow chlorotic border between necrotic and healthy green tissue. This matches both the reference image and the KB description ("V-shaped leaf lesions widest at the leaf margin, brown necrotic tissue surrounded by irregular yellowing").
